translations.en.yusufali: Say: O ye that reject Faith!

translations.en.sahih: I do not worship what you worship.
translations.en.pickthall: I worship not that which ye worship;
translations.en.yusufali: I worship not that which ye worship,
translations.id.indonesian: Aku tidak akan menyembah apa yang kamu sembah.

translations.en.sahih: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
translations.en.pickthall: Nor worship ye that which I worship.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan kamu bukan penyembah Tuhan yang aku sembah.

translations.en.sahih: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
translations.en.pickthall: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
translations.en.yusufali: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan aku tidak pernah menjadi penyembah apa yang kamu sembah,

translations.en.sahih: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
translations.en.pickthall: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
translations.en.yusufali: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
translations.id.indonesian: dan kamu tidak pernah (pula) menjadi penyembah Tuhan yang aku sembah.

translations.en.sahih: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
translations.en.pickthall: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.
translations.en.yusufali: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
